An '''unidentified Duros''' lived on [[Void Station]], working as a servant for [[Jib Kopatha]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived to Void Station, planning to extract information from the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] noticed Vader's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] arriving, and rushed to tell the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]. Kopatha didn't believe him at first, and the servant tried to convince his boss. Their conversation were interrupted when Vader entered the throne room.
